checkpoints.name: Canonical bootstrap

checkpoints.name: Forensic upstream inventory
checkpoints.exit: All four pinned source trees are cloned/indexed; generated capability ledger and runtime/test inventory exist; upstream baselines run.

checkpoints.name: Canonical contracts and Rust kernel scaffold
checkpoints.exit: Versioned schemas compile for Rust/Python/TypeScript/Swift; kernel identity/event/capability/policy skeleton passes contract tests.

checkpoints.name: OpenJarvis cognitive adapter
checkpoints.exit: OpenJarvis engine/agent/memory/trace/learning/tool/scheduler/security capabilities are mapped and parity-tested through canonical contracts.

checkpoints.name: Clicky macOS embodiment
checkpoints.exit: PTT/screen/TTS/STT/overlay/pointing/multi-monitor behaviors operate through kernel identity/session contracts with parity tests.

checkpoints.name: Unified identity, events and memory
checkpoints.exit: Cross-runtime identity/event flow and canonical memory semantics replace duplicated state without parity regression.

checkpoints.name: Unified policy and action plane
checkpoints.exit: All side effects flow through risk classification, authorization, idempotency, verification and audit; adversarial tests pass.

checkpoints.name: Cross-device and multichannel continuity
checkpoints.exit: Goals/sessions can hand off among desktop, supported mobile/wearable nodes and messaging channels without state fragmentation.

checkpoints.name: Learning and proactive autonomy
checkpoints.exit: Trace-driven routing/skill/prompt improvement and proactive goal execution operate behind evaluation/security promotion gates.

checkpoints.name: 100 percent capability parity and upstream sync
checkpoints.exit: Generated parity report is 100% VERIFIED or every exclusion has explicit waiver; upstream drift detector is operational.

checkpoints.name: Production hardening and release
checkpoints.exit: E2E, security, recovery, offline/degradation, performance, packaging, SBOM and release evidence pass on supported hardware.
